key_insight: TriGeoBench tests whether multimodal AI understands geometric structure rather than relying on superficial visual patterns.
engineering_relevance: Paired figures and executable TikZ provide a testbed for structure-aware geometry reasoning and diagram-to-code systems.
method: Construct question-answer, image, and TikZ triplets from Chinese middle- and high-school mathematics examinations.
Cover five geometry-related domains with diverse response formats.
Evaluate image-to-TikZ conversion and multimodal reasoning, including oracle tests with human-curated reference TikZ.
evidence_signal: Across 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 figures, evaluations reveal persistent fine-grained structure and image-text alignment challenges; oracle tests suggest reference TikZ supplies complementary geometric cues.
watch_item: Oracle results use human-curated TikZ and do not establish the performance of an end-to-end image-to-TikZ reasoning pipeline.
paper_title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
